cases.name: seeds-from-a-read
cases.covers: The controller reads the Info dict once when the document connects and sets it; getSnapshot() is null until then.

cases.name: a-failed-seed-read-is-ignored
cases.covers: A read that rejects (a closed document, an aborted read) leaves the state null and reports nothing.

cases.name: live-updates-from-the-event-stream
cases.covers: A metadata.updated event, own or remote, replaces the state with the metadata it carries; any other event is ignored; closing the document unsubscribes.

cases.name: update-writes-through-and-sets
cases.covers: update(patch) sends the three-state patch to the engine and resolves with its result once the confirmed metadata.updated event has set the snapshot.

cases.name: update-refused
cases.covers: An engine refusal rejects update() with the engine error and changes nothing.

cases.name: reload
cases.covers: refresh() re-reads and sets; a failed refresh rejects.

cases.name: can-edit
cases.covers: canEdit() is the doc.metadata.modify authority, wildcard included.
